name: Ley de transposición de la Directiva NIS2
description: Spanish transposition of NIS2. Supervised by INCIBE and CCN-CERT.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Boletín Oficial del Estado (boe.es) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
